name: דוח חודשי - שכר נשים 25-35 בירושלים
sql: SELECT year AS grp, AVG(COALESCE(monthly_income, 0)) AS value FROM person_year WHERE gender = 'F' AND city = 'ירושלים' AND age >= 25 AND age < 35 AND year >= 2021 AND year <= 2024 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

name: מספר רשומות לפי עיר, 2024
sql: SELECT city AS grp, COUNT(*) AS value FROM person_year WHERE year >= 2024 AND year <= 2024 GROUP BY city ORDER BY city

name: שכר ממוצע של נשים באילת
sql: SELECT year AS grp, AVG(COALESCE(monthly_income, 0)) AS value FROM person_year WHERE gender = 'F' AND city = 'אילת' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

name: בדיקה - שכר גבוה
sql: SELECT id AS grp, monthly_income AS value FROM person_year WHERE monthly_income > 22000 ORDER BY monthly_income DESC
